content.title: Reality-Error Type Takeover | Face Anchor, Letter Occlusion and Glitch Reset
content.summary: An adult signal engineer is progressively covered by a broken transmission title before a clean reset. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult character and wardrobe remain stable. + Every graphic family follows a visible body gesture. + Exact words remain readable and do not cover the face for long. + Prop counts escalate in controlled stages. + The final flash follows a centered full-body lockup and exact title.
quick_start.recommended_input: Place one original adult animated signal engineer in a silver jacket at the center of an amber-cyan transit tunnel before any large type appears. As the camera moves from full figure to chest close-up, assemble the exact title SIGNAL LOST until it fills most of the frame. Clear every band, pull back to the opening full figure and hold SIGNAL LOST clearly behind the engineer.

Typography accumulates in readable stages rather than appearing as unrelated captions.

The final frame restores both the full character and the exact master title.
